'day'::text AND jsonb_typeof(schedule -> 'day'::text) = 'string'::text AND ((schedule ->> 'day'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['月'::text, '火'::text, '水'::text, '木'::text, '金'::text])) AND schedule ? 'period'::text AND jsonb_typeof(schedule -> 'period'::text) = 'number'::text AND (schedule ->> 'period'::text) ~ '^[1-6]$'::text AND (NOT schedule ? 'starts_at'::text OR (jsonb_typeof(schedule -> 'starts_at'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['string'::text, 'null'::text]))) AND (NOT schedule ? 'ends_at'::text OR (jsonb_typeof(schedule -> 'ends_at'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['string'::text, 'null'::text])))) NOT VALID
